description: Rieckermann, Jörg at Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology publishes high-frequency conductivity and ammonium observations from wastewater infrastructure through Co-UDlabs. The 2020 campaign monitored the Engelmatte combined-sewer-overflow tank and Langmatt wastewater-treatment inlet in Lenzburg. Rainfall data form a separate bundled input; wastewater observations are CC 0 and MeteoSwiss rainfall is CC BY 4.0. Coverage is two Swiss monitoring sites during 2020; the exact high-frequency interval is not stated. Zenodo provides CSV components in a ZIP and a descriptive PDF with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is the general deposit licence does not replace the different wastewater/rainfall component terms, and sensor quality controls were not inspected. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
